mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_outbox(message_id,state,next_publish_date,publish_priority) VALUES(#{message.messageId},'NEW',#{message.sendAt},CASE WHEN #{message.campaignId} IS NULL THEN 100 ELSE 0 END)
INSERT INTO mq_outbox(message_id,state,next_publish_date,publish_priority) VALUES (#{message.messageId},'NEW',#{message.sendAt},CASE WHEN #{message.campaignId} IS NULL THEN 100 ELSE 0 END)
mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint FROM outbound_messages WHERE message_id=#{messageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_messages SET state=#{change.state}, provider_message_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{change.providerId},''),provider_message_id), whatsapp_message_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{change.wamid},''),whatsapp_message_id), submitted_date=COALESCE(submitted_date,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), sent_date=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='SENT' THEN COALESCE(sent_date,#{change.at}) ELSE sent_date END, delivered_date=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='DELIVERED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_date,#{change.at}) ELSE delivered_date END, read_date=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='READ' THEN COALESCE(read_date,#{change.at}) ELSE read_date END, failed_date=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='FAILED' THEN COALESCE(failed_date,#{change.at}) ELSE failed_date END, last_error_code=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='FAILED' THEN #{change.errorCode} ELSE last_error_code END, last_error_message=CASE WHEN #{change.incoming}='FAILED' THEN 'YCloud 明确返回失败，请按错误码核对' ELSE last_error_message END, lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL,message_version=message_version+1,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{change.messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT outbox_id,message_id,publish_attempts FROM mq_outbox WHERE state='NEW' AND next_publish_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY publish_priority DESC,outbox_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='PUBLISHING',publish_attempts=publish_attempts+1, lock_owner=#{owner},lock_expire_date=#{lockedUntil},update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state='NEW' AND outbox_id IN #{id}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='PUBLISHED',published_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL, last_error=NULL,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND state='PUBLISHING' AND lock_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='NEW',next_publish_date=#{change.nextTime},last_error=#{change.error},lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL, update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox_id=#{change.outboxId} AND state='PUBLISHING' AND lock_owner=#{change.owner}
UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='NEW',lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL, update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state='PUBLISHING' AND lock_expire_date<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE outbound_messages SET state='SUBMITTING',lock_owner=#{owner},lock_expire_date=#{lockedUntil},attempt_count=attempt_count+1, update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') AND send_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND next_attempt_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT message_id FROM outbound_messages WHERE state='SUBMITTING' AND lock_expire_date<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LIMIT 200 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_messages SET state='FAILED',last_error_code=#{change.code},last_error_message=#{change.error},failed_date=#{change.at}, lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL,message_version=message_version+1,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{change.messageId} AND state='SUBMITTING'

UPDATE outbound_messages SET state='UNKNOWN',last_error_code=#{change.code},last_error_message=#{change.error}, lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL,message_version=message_version+1,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{change.messageId} AND state='SUBMITTING'

UPDATE outbound_messages SET state='RETRY_WAIT',last_error_code=#{change.code},last_error_message=#{change.error},next_attempt_date=#{change.at}, lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL,message_version=message_version+1,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{change.messageId} AND state='SUBMITTING'
UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='NEW',next_publish_date=#{nextTime},last_error=NULL,lock_owner=NULL,lock_expire_date=NULL, update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id FROM outbound_messages WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') ORDER BY message_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_messages SET state='CANCELLED',message_version=message_version+1,update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE mq_outbox SET state='CANCELLED',update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state IN ('NEW','PUBLISHING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbound_messages m WHERE m.message_id=mq_outbox.message_id AND m.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND m.state='CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mq_outbox WHERE state IN ('NEW','PUBLISHING')
